market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. 4th consecutive equity loss day with oil at $108, yields at multiyear highs, and CPI-driven hike expectations. Bessent's failed buyback undermines confidence. Expect continued volatility and risk-off flows. S&P 500 breaking 50-day MA is a technical sell signal. 1-3 months: further downside unless oil stabilizes below $95.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on AI infrastructure, energy, and defense. Consumer and discretionary face structural headwinds from rate environment. 6-12 months: if Fed hikes 25-50bps total, recession risk rises but AI capex cycle and energy transition provide growth pockets. Watch for overcapacity in renewables to create M&A opportunities.
